payments.policy: Legacy UI payments means payment collection only. It grants no ownership of refund, settlement or payout facts.

capacity.policy: Capacity is a grouping, not one authority leaf. Ask which qualified-resource records, schedule constraints, actual reservations or stock facts are covered and bind each selected canonical leaf explicitly. Do not automatically copy one authority to all candidates.

finance.policy: Finance is a grouping. Payment, refund, settlement and payout have independently confirmed owners and outcomes.

componentBridges.rule: A lead value fills only that component; horizon/cutoff remain unresolved. Zero is valid.
Legacy minimum value/unit fills only minimum; calendar basis, maximum and billing policy require explicit setup.
Person-only integer normalizes to quantity_minor=N, scale=0, unit=person in an explicit pool/occurrence context. It cannot fill area/volume/weight.

compositeLegacyBridge.policy: instant_authority_confirmed maps to intake instant_after_requirements; merchant_accepts maps to merchant_approval. external_system_confirms identifies external ownership only and leaves intake unresolved. Never infer source authority or approval from a single mixed token.

compatibilityRules: BQ_BUFFERS is not an alias for Q_PREPARATION_MINUTES: production preparation workload is not necessarily occupied resource buffer.
BQ_TRAVEL_POLICY reuses Q_SERVICE_AREA through a reference and adds travel rules; capture coverage only once.
BQ_RANGE_POLICY retains Q_MINIMUM_RENTAL_DURATION as a minimum component, with separate maximum/calendar basis/billing policy.
BQ_BOOKING_WINDOW retains exact lead as a component and adds horizon/cutoff; do not ask both component and compound editor for the same scope.
BQ_CAPACITY is typed pool/occurrence capacity, while Q_CAPACITY_LIMIT is a person-only component compatibility view; no generalized unit conversion is implied.
BQ_PAYMENT_POLICY is an approved policy reference, not a second deposit amount. Existing price/deposit/amount answers can draft policy inputs, with finance-owner validation before publication.
